links.outcome: AI accuracy in geographically distinct population and different EEG equipment versus expert gold standard
links.effect: Overall accuracy 92% (95% CI 90%-94%) for SCORE-AI versus 94% (92%-96%) for experts; no significant difference for any metric or category.
links.quote: SCORE-AI achieved diagnostic performance equal to human experts in an EEG dataset independent of the development dataset, in a geographically distinct patient population, recorded with different equipment and technical settings than the development dataset.

links.outcome: AI diagnostic accuracy compared with three blinded experts on same EEG data
links.effect: Overall accuracy 92% (95% CI 90%-94%) for SCORE-AI versus 94% (95% CI 92%-96%) for experts; no significant difference for any metric or category.
links.quote: SCORE-AI performed equally well compared to the experts, with an overall accuracy of 92% (95% confidence interval [CI] = 90%-94%) versus 94% (95% CI = 92%-96%).

screen.reason: External validation study evaluating generalizability and diagnostic accuracy of an existing AI model (SCORE-AI) against expert human readers on an independent, geographically distinct EEG dataset.
